name: visitkorea-mcp / visitkorea-wellnesstourism-mcp / visitkorea-medicaltourism-mcp (family of repos by leejaew and others)
what_it_holds: MCP server wrappers around Korea Tourism Organization's public TourAPI / EngService2 (data.go.kr) — live API clients for attractions, restaurants, accommodations, festivals, wellness and medical tourism facility listings. These are point-of-interest/facility APIs, NOT visitor-arrival statistics.
why_useful: Confirms KTO's open API surface is machine-accessible and unauthenticated-friendly, but the specific APIs wrapped here are POI/attraction directories, not the inbound-arrivals or nights series the theme needs (Korea's actual monthly arrivals stats live on KTO's separate statistics portal, not TourAPI). Cataloguing as a method pointer only, not a data source for the KPI itself.

name: Acceso a series INEGI por Python
what_it_holds: Small standalone Python script (no stars) built specifically because INEGIpy broke after INEGI's 2025-26 series-key overhaul; re-implements direct access to INEGI time series (BIE) by the new keys.
why_useful: Secondary/backup method for pulling INEGI series (including tourism/hospitality indicators) if INEGIpy_v2 also lags the current API; low-maturity but addresses a real, recently-broken access path relevant to any Mexico DATATUR/INEGI work.
duplicate_of_holding: Overlaps INEGIpy_v2 -- keep as fallback only

name: mcp-tour
what_it_holds: An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server integration wrapping the Korea Tourism Organization's (KTO) public API, intended for use with Claude Desktop -- effectively a ready-made client/tool wrapper around KTO's TourAPI.
why_useful: KTO is explicitly named in this theme (Korea international arrivals/visitor data); this repo is a thin wrapper that could shortcut building a KTO API client, though it targets KTO's general tourism-content API rather than confirmed to expose the visitor-arrivals statistics endpoint specifically -- needs verification of which KTO endpoints it actually calls.
